research_question: Can the official National Register boundary (Genesse, West Dallas, Arthur, and West Gray Streets) be converted into a defensible polygon or centroid using Harris County parcel or GIS data?
suggested_sources: Harris County Appraisal District GIS data
City of Houston GIS / Planning and Development Department
National Register nomination form (requires OCR or manual review; see ft_source_002)
notes: A street-bounded description is not itself a coordinate. Do not infer an arbitrary centroid from the boundary streets alone.
